title: CPSC, Select Comfort Announce Recall of Adjustable Beds
summary: When exposed to severely cold temperatures and impact, such as may occur during shipping, the power cord insulation on the electric air pump can crack, creating a short-circuit or exposing live electrical wires and presenting a shock or electrocution hazard. Units: 90,000.

title: CPSC, Toshiba America Consumer Products Announce Recall of Rear Projection Televisions
summary: If the capacitors short circuit, due to a very high electrical surge, such as from a lightening strike, the metal parts on the television could present a shock or electrocution hazard. title: CPSC, American Promotional Events Inc. Announce Recall of Fireworks
summary: The firework device has a defective base and can break during launch. If reused, the launching device could then send fireworks in unintended directions, possible causing injury. Units: About 22,700.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of GSW Water Heaters With S.I.T. Temperature Controls
summary: A potential burn hazard from ignition flashback or an increase in tank water temperature. Units: 13,000 (In addition, 140,000 units were sold in Canada).

title: CPSC, Franzus Company LLC Announce Recall of International Adapter Plugs
summary: The adapter plug can separate, exposing live electrical conductors, posing an electrocution and shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 29,000.

title: CPSC, JAKKS Pacific Announce Recall of "Spit Smatter" Spray Foam
summary: The aerosol cans can forcefully break apart, posing a risk of serious injury to nearby consumers. Units: About 1.3 million.

title: CPSC, Perfect Fit Industries Announce Recall of Electric Blankets
summary: These blankets can overheat, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers, especially when the blanket is folded or bunched. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Small Small World Announce Recall of "Egg Dippers" Easter Plush Toys
summary: The toys' seams can separate and allow small beads to be released, presenting an aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 75,000.

title: CPSC, Black & Decker Announce Recall to Repair 18-volt Cordless Drill/Drivers
summary: The drill's switch can malfunction and overheat, posing the possibility of a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 265,000.

title: CPSC, De Bon Sales Announce Recall of Cigarette Lighters
summary: The novelty lighters are not equipped with child-resistant mechanisms. They pose fire and burn hazards to young children. Units: 8,000.

title: CPSC, DesignPac Announce Recall of Lamp Oil
summary: The bottles of paraffin oil in these sets do not have the child-resistant closures required by federal law. Units: 4,000.

title: CPSC, Hamilton Beach and Proctor-Silex Announce Recall of Slow Cookers
summary: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot food spilling onto consumers. Units: 2.7 million.

title: CPSC, Midwest Announce Recall of Toad Lawn Sprinklers
summary: A small hose inside the toad can fail, allowing water to fill the toad's cavity. The increased water pressure can cause the toad to explode, posing the risk of injury to anyone nearby. Units: 4,000.

title: CPSC, UWATEC Announce Recall of Smart Dive Computers
summary: The computer's alert signal system may not work properly and the computer screen may freeze. This may cause inaccurate information to be displayed, such as water depth, tank pressure, and ascent rate, posing a risk to the safety of a diver. Units: 6,000.

title: CPSC, Toro Company Recall Riding Lawn Mowers
summary: The actuator arm could fail, resulting in a loss of transmission control and risk of personal injury. Units: 7,500.

title: CPSC, Cervélo Cycles Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Forks
summary: The forks on the bicycles can develop cracks near the crown area, resulting in failure of the fork and posing a risk of injury to the rider. Units: About 317.

title: CPSC, Hedstrom Corp. Announce Recall of Trampolines
summary: Welds on the frame of these trampolines can break during use, causing consumers to fall to the ground and suffer injuries. Units: About 116,000.

title: CPSC, Ideal Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Voltage Testers
summary: These testers can short out at high voltages. Consumers can suffer burns. Units: About 122,000.

title: CPSC, International Playthings Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Stacking Rings
summary: Plastic knobs on the rings can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. Announce Recall of Kids Sling Chair
summary: The small plastic bolt covers pose a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 75,200.
